title: A mark's highlight stays on its passage when the reply reflows
body:
`Mark` in `app.rs` records a marked passage as its entry, plus the line offset and screen column of each end within that entry, taken from the layout at the moment of marking. `draw_transcript` in `ui.rs` highlights those cells on each draw. When the reply lays out again at another width, after a resize or a change of the scroll bar, its lines wrap differently. The highlight then covers other text, while the passage sent to the agent stays as marked.

## Open

- Whether to anchor a mark to the reply's rendered text, as a character range, and find its cells again on each layout.
